content:
olivia-docs: Hey team — opened a docs PR for the pricing + quotas page to include the new tiered rate limits and the usage dashboard links. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/412

matt-platform: Thanks — I skimmed it. Two quick asks: 1) add a short explainer for how burst tokens vs sustained quota is enforced, 2) include the /v1/usage-metering API example.

olivia-docs: On it. For the burst vs sustained note, would this sentence work? 'Burst quota allows short spikes above your sustained limit up to the burst cap; sustained quota is averaged over a rolling 1h window.'

jess-product: That reads fine. Also please clarify billing unit for embeddings vs text tokens — lots of customers trip on that. Something like: 'Embeddings are billed per embedding request unit (ERU), text is billed per token.'

kevin-eng: Quick technical note — the metering API returns both "token_units" and "embedding_units" fields now. Docs should show code parsing both. Example JS snippet we prefer: ```js
const res = await client.get('/v1/usage', { params: { start, end } });
console.log(res.data.usage.token_units, res.data.usage.embedding_units);
```

olivia-docs: perfect, I'll include that snippet (will keep it short). Also planning a small migration note: 'If you have custom rate-limit rules, map them to tiered policies using the migration tool: /console/migrate-quotas'. Want me to link the migration tool docs?

matt-platform: yes link it. And add a short sentence about fallbacks — i.e., when quota is exceeded we return 429 with header X-Quota-Remaining set to 0 and Retry-After in seconds.

nina-analytics: Also add a dashboard screenshot and an anchor to the analytics export section. We shipped CSV export last week — note customers can export daily aggregates for billing reconciliation. 

olivia-docs: Screenshot queued — need a perm link from ops for the staging dashboard. @kevin-eng can you share the staging dashboard URL?

kevin-eng: staging link: https://staging.console.redwood.ai/dashboards/usage-quickview (it's behind SSO, will post public demo link later). Also FYI deploy-bot will validate embeds/images size on PR.

deploy-bot: build/test checks started for docs PR #412 — image-size-check OK, link-checker running.

jess-product: One more micro ask — update the SDK snippet to show how to read quota headers in Python too. Something like: ```py
resp = client.generate(... )
print(resp.headers.get('X-Quota-Remaining'))
```

olivia-docs: Great. I'll push one more commit with the JS + Python snippets, migration link, quota header details, and the dashboard screenshot placeholder. I'll request reviews from @matt-platform and @nina-analytics once ready. Thanks all :pray:

matt-platform: Thanks olivia, will review after deploy-bot completes checks. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: link-checker completed — 1 broken link (staging dashboard), marking as warning.

olivia-docs: noted — I'll remove the staging URL and add the public demo link once kevin posts it. Updating PR now.

kevin-eng: posted public demo link in the PR comments.

olivia-docs: closing loop — PR updated and ready for review: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/412/files. Marking checklist: [x] burst vs sustained text, [x] JS snippet, [x] Python snippet, [x] migration link (placeholder), [ ] screenshot (pending).
